items.prompt: An exhaustive short sequential FIFO test passes for this function. Which conclusion is supported?

options.text: The tested sequential outputs and indexes match the reference.
options.why: The evidence is about tested ordered calls, not interleavings or a target memory model.

options.text: Concurrent publication is safe because Python executes these calls in order.
options.why: A sequential schedule does not test atomic visibility between producer and consumer.

options.text: Lock-free progress follows from O(1) index work.
options.why: A bound on sequential work does not establish nonblocking progress under concurrency.

options.text: Every target CPU supplies the required acquire/release ordering.
options.why: No target atomic protocol or memory-order implementation is tested here.

items.explanation: The evidence is about tested ordered calls, not interleavings or a target memory model.
